title: Statistical code and de-identified analysis data for: Short versus prolonged antibiotic therapy for complicated urinary tract infection in kidney transplant recipients: a target trial emulation
description: Statistical code, a Quarto report, and de-identified analysis data accompanying the study Short versus prolonged antibiotic therapy for complicated urinary tract infection in kidney transplant recipients: a target trial emulation. The study compares sensitivity antibiotic therapy stopped by day 13 with therapy continued to day 14 or beyond. The analyses include propensity score matching, recurrence-free survival, relapse analyses, and a two-period approximation to clone-censor-weight analysis.
